trap.label: verbo errado
trap.wrong: The vet made a surgery on the horse.
trap.right: The vet performed surgery on the horse.
trap.why: Em português “fazer uma cirurgia” leva a make/do; em inglês usa-se perform ou operate on, e surgery é incontável.

mcq.q: Which line is short, technical and authoritative?
opts: She said that maybe it could possibly be colic.
She was saying it is colic, I think.
mcq.why: Fala técnica é curta e sem hesitação.
Pass a tube é a combinação usada.

fix.wrong: The vet palpated on the abdomen.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “The vet palpates the abdomen.”
Troque “perform surgery on” por “operate on”: “They performed surgery on the mare.”
Reescreva na negativa: “The horse passed manure.”
rewrite.answer: The horse did not pass manure.
